title: AegisKV current-design evaluation plan

implementation_status.note: Existing static/toy/older simulator evidence does not validate fixed slots, exclusive ownership and lazy lower-tier credit together.

design_contract.managed_owner: exclusive stable Peer/DRAM/storage owner; transient copies both charged
design_contract.peer_quota: fixed calibrated L/K per model/layout; total cap via guarded AIMD
design_contract.lower_credit: per-Agent, independent pools, actual-use-only renewal, paid rent retained

W3.kind: controlled sequential/balanced/heterogeneous fork-join; ten each, with repeated calls/tool returns

primary_policies.H-LRU: tuned hierarchical LRU, same safe execution/Adapter/Router and recency Peer slots; all-active eligibility, own eligible-backlog demand
primary_policies.Reuse: normal next-use saved work/byte, same physical budgets/safety; all-active eligibility, own eligible-backlog demand
primary_policies.AegisKV: current fixed-slot exclusive three-tier lazy-credit design
primary_policies.Recompute: no added fault-safe KV; ordinary local reuse and accepted-token log

reference_variants.All-DRAM: resource-relaxed fit reference, not equal-budget competitor
reference_variants.ordinary_gds: static object cost/size with ordinary GDS pressure aging
reference_variants.unlimited_eager: eager refresh without matched work cap; cost reference
reference_variants.frozen_placement: skip optional online replacement, keep required safe relief
reference_variants.duplicate_backing: retain redundant lower copy; all bytes charged under equal total physical cap
reference_variants.adaptive_lk: per-request adaptive quota reference under matched total cap/work budget
reference_variants.fixed_peer_cap: fixed Peer authorization at common configured cap

fault_contract.primary: anchor workflow/Agent/segment/request at 80 percent frozen total-token progress; kill whole source replica
fault_contract.unreached_trigger: keep in ledger and original cohort; no anchor substitution

statistics.top_level_unit: independently launched paired campaign within comparison block
statistics.primary_contrast: per-workflow own-policy F1-F0, then baseline-AegisKV, aggregate within campaign before bootstrap
statistics.completion: common administrative horizon; completion fraction plus mean min(T,tau); never fill eventual latency

offline_tasks.unit: distinct seeded protocol interleaving; not serving campaign

historical_evidence_policy: retain original labels/raw values and negative outcomes; never promote static/toy/trace-driven curves to current-controller measured results
parameter_resolution: shared defaults -> named variant overrides -> cell factor_levels; execution fields also receive explicit factor overrides. Every cell is a separate planned comparison-block observation; repeated controls across blocks are intentional.
